story.text: Built for staying: fast Wi-Fi and a room full of laptops made the Malviya Nagar café, near World Trade Park, a go-to for people who work remotely.

source.title: Town Coffee in Jaipur: Perfect Cafe for Digital Nomads

story.text: A menu that goes beyond the cup, with mezze platters, sandwiches and baked pasta alongside coffee and cold drinks: somewhere you can stay for lunch, not just a latte.

source.title: Town Coffee in Jaipur: Perfect Cafe for Digital Nomads

story.text: The format has travelled: Town Coffee now appears in both areas we track, Malviya Nagar and C-Scheme.
